dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Chloe has shown signs of fearfulness while in the care center and is slowly beginning to warm up with a patient, gentle, and considerate approach. She will benefit from an experienced owner who can provide her with the time, understanding, and patience she needs to feel safe and comfortable in her new home.

Her owner describes her as very social and affectionate dog who enjoys being around people and spends most of her time wherever her people are, especially in the bedroom. She is generally pretty laid-back and loves lounging around. Chloe goes to the groomer for her grooming needs. On walks, she has mild to moderate pulling on the leash and typically goes for 3-4 walks per day, lasting approximately 15 minutes each. She has never been crated. Chloe does not particularly enjoy car rides and may whine and pant when getting into or riding in the car. She knows the basic cues "sit" and "stay."
dog.name: Chloe
